description.value: Four Winds B&B is a small guest house on Saturna Island, one of BC's Southern Gulf Islands, accessible only by ferry or floatplane. Suites include in-room kitchenettes, smart TVs, and ocean views, making it a self-sufficient base for island exploration. A sister property, Sandy Bay B&B, is within walking distance, and the island has a pub, café, and general store nearby.

address.value: 443 East Point Road, Saturna, B.C. V0N 2Y0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and provides address (443 East Point Road, Saturna), phone ((250) 539-5463), and a clear amenities list. The /about page explicitly lists 'Free Fast Wi-Fi' and in-room kitchenettes; the /rooms page explicitly states 'Breakfast is no longer available' and 'pets are not allowed in the suites.' No mention anywhere of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, tools, or e-bike charging. The /events page lists local dining and grocery options on-island. OSM had no phone or address so those fields are sourced from the website.
concerns: OSM record had no phone or address; both sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone and contact_confirmed.address are unverifiable against OSM.
Website copyright reads '© 2017' suggesting content may not be actively maintained; amenity list could be outdated.
No bike-specific information (storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate B&B on a cycling-accessible Gulf Island with confirmed Wi-Fi and nearby food/grocery, but neither required criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) is mentioned anywhere on the website and cannot be confirmed without direct contact.
enrichment_extras.notes: The property notes a 'sister B&B' (Sandy Bay Bed and Breakfast) within walking distance — may warrant a separate OSM record check to avoid duplicate listings.
